Pipeline monitoring for data engineering teams

Northwind Analytics is monitoring software for data engineering teams. It watches the latency and freshness of your data pipelines and tells you a table has gone stale before a stakeholder opens a dashboard and finds yesterday’s numbers.

Start a 14-day trial

What Northwind Analytics does

Northwind Analytics connects to Snowflake, BigQuery and Postgres, records how long each pipeline run takes, and learns the normal completion window for every table. When a run finishes late or a table stops updating, Northwind Analytics raises an alert that names the table, the pipeline and the last good run. Teams using Northwind Analytics reduced their median time to detect a stale table from 4 hours to 11 minutes across the 2025 customer cohort.

Who it is for

Northwind Analytics is built for data engineering teams of three to fifty people who already run scheduled pipelines and need to know when those pipelines silently stop producing fresh data.
